cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Don't call the taxi yet. We're packed, but we haven't settled last night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised for telling my sister about your debt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Stay a minute. I can't face her checking what I order tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's already paid for dinner. We'll be late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll be late. Sit with me and help me believe you're coming as my partner, not to report how grateful I am.

mechanism: A controls departure timing and grants only a delay that addresses broken trust, making relational reassurance a condition of leaving together.
confusable: Demanding an apology alone is not D74; A must keep the person present after the practical readiness to leave.
comparison: A partner facing debt disclosure at family dinner differs from a post-cleanup conversation with a last bus limit.
seedUse: Use D74-b disclosure and prepaid dinner pressure; make permission to leave explicitly hinge on reassurance rather than a pasted decision phrase.
